Counsel for Applicant :- Ashutosh Misra
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1. Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned A.G.A. for the State.
2. The applicant seeks enlargement on bail in Fir No.80 of 2024, under Section 498A, 304B Ipc &
Section 3/4 of D.P. Act, P.S. Itaunja, District Lucknow.

3.  Learned counsel for the applicant submits that co-accusedMohd. Idrees , who is father in law,
having similar has been granted bail by this Court vide order dated5.9.2024 passed inCRIMINAL MISC. BAIL APPLICATION No. - 9487 of 2024 .

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 4. Learned A.G.A. opposes the bail application.

5. Considering the allegations against the applicant to be similar the co-accused who has been enlarged on bail and the adopting the same reasoning as para 3 and 5 of the aforesaid bail order, the applicant, who has no criminal history, is enlarged on bail on the ground of parity.
Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.

6. Let the applicant Mohd. Shadab be released on bail in the abovesaid first information report number on his furnishing personal bonds and two reliable sureties each to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offences of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
Order Date :- 4.10.2024 Anuj Singh  Mohd. Shadab vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home ... on 4 October, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/68495752/
